active_alert.headline: Large Group / Catering Ticket Spike (Average Ticket $53.41 vs $39.13 Usual)
active_alert.immediate_present_status: Counter ticket size jumped to $53.41/order (+36% above normal). Multiple high-density platters (King of the Hill $145, Bevo $79, Pitmaster $54) or bulk meat pounds are clearing the cutting block.
active_alert.causal_explanation: Large office/family group orders concentrated in the 11:00 AM EST window. While ticket volume (26 orders) is steady, meat poundage per transaction has doubled, pulling multiple briskets from holding.
active_alert.recommended_pit_action: Carve whole briskets to order rather than pre-slicing to preserve moisture; alert the prep cook to replenish bulk pint containers of potato salad and mac & cheese.

Prep Target.definition: How much cooked meat, sides and raw stock should be ready at each shift change so we don't run out or over-prep.
Prep Target.how_it_helps: Keeps us from 86ing meat at lunch and cuts end-of-day waste by setting clear morning and afternoon slicing amounts.

Average Ticket.definition: The average dollar amount per order: total sales divided by number of orders.
Average Ticket.how_it_helps: Shows whether a busy hour is lots of small sandwich orders or a few big platters ($145 King of the Hill), so the cutting board can pace whole-brisket slicing.

Rush Signal.definition: How far this hour's orders are above what we usually see at this hour on this day of the week. The bigger the number, the more unusual the rush.
Rush Signal.how_it_helps: Ignores normal small ups and downs, so an alert means a real rush that needs the pitmaster's attention.

Meat Used Per Hour.definition: How many pounds of finished meat get carved and pulled from the 140°F holding cabinet each hour.
Meat Used Per Hour.how_it_helps: Warns the pitmaster hours ahead if we'll sell out before dinner, leaving time to adjust portions or push sausage combos.

Cooked Yield %.definition: How much sellable meat is left after trimming and smoking: finished sliced weight ÷ raw weight × 100.
Cooked Yield %.how_it_helps: Shows the real yield of meat on the board. Whole packer brisket yields about 35% (5.75 lbs cooked per 16.4 lb packer) after trimming and smoking to finished sliceable yield.

Shrinkage.definition: Weight lost during smoking as moisture cooks off and fat renders (about 65% for brisket, 56% for pork butt).
Shrinkage.how_it_helps: Guides smoker humidity and wrap timing. Too much shrinkage means dry meat and less to sell.

Tallow Rest.definition: Holding finished brisket wrapped with warm beef tallow at about 145°F until it's sliced.
Tallow Rest.how_it_helps: Keeps brisket juicy and hot for hours, so an early cook can still be sold at dinner.

Est. Meat Cost.definition: What we pay for the meat in a menu item, plus rub, sauce, butcher paper and to-go containers.
Est. Meat Cost.how_it_helps: Shows the real cost per serving so prices still work when beef prices move.

Meat Cost %.definition: Est. Meat Cost divided by the menu price, as a percentage.
Meat Cost %.how_it_helps: Texas BBQ usually aims for 28–32%. Items over 40% (like a brisket sandwich sold alone) need a price or portion fix.

Left After Meat Cost.definition: The share of each sale left after paying for the meat: (menu price − Est. Meat Cost) ÷ menu price × 100.
Left After Meat Cost.how_it_helps: This is the money that pays the crew, post oak deliveries, rent and smoker upkeep.

Typical Day.definition: What a normal day looks like for that weekday, averaged from past Clover sales (for example, Typical Tuesday).
Typical Day.how_it_helps: Gives every number a fair comparison, so a slow Tuesday isn't measured against a busy Saturday.

Hourly Orders.definition: Orders or dollars coming in per hour right now.
Hourly Orders.how_it_helps: Shows when the lunch and dinner rushes start building, so the cutting board can get ahead of the line.

Sales Trend.definition: How sales move with something else, like temperature or rain, measured across many past days.
Sales Trend.how_it_helps: Turns 'rainy days feel slow' into a number you can plan prep around.
